Aurora Winter Blues Festival Pass: Choose all 4 evening and 2 matinee performances (6 Shows) for $199 – discount at checkout Aurora Cultural Centre Presents Glenn Marais’ Jook Aurora Winter Blues Festival Aurora Town Square Performance Hall 50 Victoria Street, Aurora 12:15 pm Doors Open 1:00 pm Show Start Glenn Marais is a celebrated Canadian bluesman whose powerful voice and poignant songwriting tackle injustice with heart and soul. A Juno-nominated artist and internationally recognized advocate, Glenn has performed across the globe—from South Africa to Memphis—and collaborated on one of Canada’s most played radio hits, “Everybody Wants to Be Like You.” His latest work, Jook: The Story of the Blues, is a stirring tribute to the roots of the blues and the resilience of Black communities during the Great Migration. Marais blends history, lived experience, and music into a moving journey of struggle, strength, and liberation. About the Aurora Winter Blues Festival Get ready to warm up your winter! The Aurora Winter Blues Festival is back with four nights of toe-tapping, soul-shaking, heart-thumping music. Presented by the Aurora Cultural Centre, AWBF is your mid-winter escape into the world of blues, roots, and everything in between. It’s cozy, it’s cool, and it’s the perfect way to turn up the heat this February. This presentation is made possible with the support of Season Sponsor Funders The Aurora Cultural Centre participates in the Access 2 Program and supports removing the barriers to arts access for patrons with disabilities and their support persons.
